scientific_integrity: Direct analytic proof of four target cases, symbolic resolvent and derivative identities, plus 600 finite-generator checks. Finite tests not used to infer infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only two cliques linked by exactly one edge, source a left nonbridge vertex, independently rate-one edge clocks, independent Poisson reset to the source. General renewal theory is prior knowledge; residual earlier-specialization overlap risk.
title: An all-rate target-location classification for resetting search on bridge-barbells
